introHtml: Unisex flashing blinky lights are designed to appeal to any wearer, making them ideal for safety vests, lanyards, or giveaways at events where visibility matters. Choose from multiple flash patterns and imprint your logo for a functional branded safety accessory that keeps your team or attendees visible in low-light conditions.
